verdict.rationale: The evidence shows the Sandbox SDK can manage background processes inside a container (docs-43). That is a developer primitive for running long-lived commands. It is not a documented way to set up automations that trigger and run on their own, and the pack shows no scheduling, recurring triggers or autonomous automation features. A one-off background process is not a recurring, self-running automation, so this is adjacent support only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
